name: Aloo Paratha
description: Crispy Pakistani whole-wheat flatbread stuffed with a well-seasoned potato filling, served with yogurt, pickle or chai.
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes, boiled, cooled and mashed
½ tsp chaat masala or garam masala, optional
method: Mix the flour with about ½ tsp salt. Add water gradually and knead into a soft, smooth dough. Cover and rest for 15–20 minutes.
Mix the cooled mashed potatoes with green chilies, coriander, red chili, roasted cumin, remaining salt and optional chaat masala. Keep the filling fairly dry and lump-free.
Divide the dough and filling into equal portions. Roll one dough portion into a small disc, place potato filling in the centre, bring the edges together and seal well.
Dust lightly with flour and roll gently into an even paratha, taking care not to tear the dough.
Place on a hot tawa and cook until light spots appear. Flip, spread a little ghee or oil, then cook both sides until golden-brown and cooked through.
Serve immediately with yogurt, pickle or chutney.
tips: Cool the potatoes before filling; hot or wet filling makes the dough difficult to roll.
Add water to the dough gradually so it stays soft without becoming sticky.
storage: Best served fresh. Refrigerate cooked leftovers covered and reheat thoroughly on a tawa.
